case_name: A.V. Papayya Sastry and Others v Government of Andhra Pradesh and Others
holding: The Supreme Court holds that the High Court was right in recalling the earlier order and remanding the case to the authorities to decide afresh in accordance with law.
This is not a fit case which calls for our intervention u/art. 136 of the Constitution.
We decline to grant special leave to appeal against any judgment, decree, determination, sentence or order in any cause or matter passed or made by any Court or Tribunal in India.
